error.invalid_url: Enter a valid SpielerPlus ICS URL

account.title: SpielerPlus sign-in
account.description: Read-only access to your response and aggregate counts. Credentials are stored in local Home Assistant configuration and may be included in backups. No member names or absence reasons are imported. Additional sign-in steps such as 2FA are not yet automated.

team.title: Choose team membership
team.description: Choose the membership corresponding to this calendar.

disable.title: Remove account sign-in
disable.description: Remove the optional sign-in from active configuration. The ICS calendar stays configured.

error.unsupported_login: This sign-in needs an unsupported additional step. Use the website; do not disable account protections.
error.access_denied: SpielerPlus denied access. No attendance responses were changed.
error.no_memberships: No matching team membership was found.
error.response_too_large: The response exceeds the size limit.
error.unexpected_response: The response was not recognized. The website may have changed.

abort.no_memberships: No matching team membership was found.
